sense.text:
The Most High says, “I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing.” But he gives the answer with it: “therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live.” Life is a choice, and the way to choose it is by applying the scriptures.

Be honest: if many of us were still living the way we lived back in the days, we would be dead already. Now that we are in the truth the bar has to be raised, because sickness is destroying the nation. Brothers are losing their legs, brothers are diabetic, overweight, with cholesterol and heart problems. You have to choose to live, because the longer you live the more work you get to do. Care about your nation enough to say, I am going to take care of myself so I can live as long as possible and help the nation.

The Most High can take anyone when it is their time, even the healthiest person. That is not the point here, just as the rare case is not the point when the world argues about abortion. The point is that a man can rush his own death. It is your temple and your choice, but the scripture tells you which choice to make.

How can anyone count on you if you have given up on yourself? We say we are the light, so be the light all the way. People are watching, and they notice a big belly. How can we be the wisest people on earth and still be dealing with diabetes, high blood pressure and cholesterol? Where is the wisdom, if it is not applied?

precepts.why:
“Seek not death in the error of your life.” There are mistakes a man can make that will kill him, and overeating is one of them: eat too much and you may end up dead. We have a lot of sick people among us, and the reason we are sick is food.

A brother kept saying he ate one meal a day and could not lose weight. Calories in, calories out is simple mathematics. Then he ran down his day: yogurt in the morning, a salad for lunch, peanuts and almonds in between, dinner at night, and more nuts before bed. That is not one meal. One meal means one meal; coffee or tea, and that is about it. Brothers be lying to themselves.

“And pull not upon yourselves destruction with the works of your hands.” To eat, you need your hands. The man stuffing himself until he can barely breathe is pulling destruction on himself with the works of his hands. That is a recipe for death.

We all struggle with something. One brother struggles with porn, another with smoking, and somebody in the truth is still struggling with bacon on the low, still keeping ham and lard in the fridge from Christianity. Everybody came in with issues and got better over time; food is the issue some have not dealt with. This is how you choose death instead of the life Deuteronomy sets before you.

sense.text:
“In the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils”, “Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats”. This is dealing straight up with the Catholic Church, which says not to eat meat on certain days. The Seventh Day Adventists highly recommend a vegetarian diet.

The Bible says you should eat meat. If you are sick to a certain level, going vegan for a time can help, but it has been shown that the less meat you eat, the smaller your brain gets. Your brain feeds off meat.

The meats God created are “to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.” Read verse 3 again: they are received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth, and the truth is the law.

“For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving”. Somebody is still struggling with that verse. People who believe Christ is black and believe they are Israelites still say, everything is good, I can eat whatever I want, just pray on it. Can I pray over a human foot and eat it?

Every creature is good for the work it was made to do. Pork carries the worm called trichinella, which gets into the muscles and even the brain; a man from Argentina had part of his brain missing from it. The Most High can release the worms on you and expose you for eating pork on the low, the same way brothers get caught in every other sin.

Shrimp, lobsters and all the shellfish clean the ocean. Anyone who has kept a fish tank knows what the filter looks like when you change it; cook that and you are eating shrimp. Bottom feeders like catfish, snails and shrimp are natural tank cleaners. Put crabs or any bottom feeder in murky, dirty water and in a few hours it will be crystal clear, because that is their job; that is why shrimp are called the roaches of the sea. A pleco in a fish tank is never fed, yet it grows bigger than the other fish, because it eats the algae and the poop of the other fish. Their key purpose is waste management. How can you eat something whose job is to get rid of waste and expect it to do you good? That is where the gout, the high cholesterol and the hypertension come from, and brothers lose fingers and feet to it. City Island seafood, Massachusetts clam chowder: don’t do that thing. If you eat something that eats garbage, it is going to make you sick. But we are too greedy, and even in the truth, some who no longer eat that garbage still love food too much.

“For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.” The Christians never read on to this verse. A creature is not made clean by praying over it. It is sanctified by the word of God, so you have to go to the word and see which animals were sanctified to be eaten and which were not.

precepts.why:
“And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.” This is what makes every creature good: each is good to serve its purpose, not good to eat.

We don’t eat worms, but one of the best ways to prepare land for planting is to have a mass of worms in it. Pigs were the garbage disposal: back in the days there were no trucks coming by to take your garbage, there was a pigsty, and the pigs ate everything you put there. A hyena is good for its purpose too, but you can’t keep one, because it will eat you as well.

So when 1 Timothy says every creature of God is good, it is speaking of creatures that God saw were good for the work he made them for.

The meats God created are to be received “of them which believe and know the truth.” What is the truth? “Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.”

The truth is the law. Putting a thanksgiving on your plate does not make it lawful; the thanksgiving belongs to those who know the law and eat by it.

And what is it to believe? “He that believeth in the Lord taketh heed to the commandment”. If you take heed to the commandments, you believe. The Christians do not believe in the commandments, so when they say you can eat anything received with thanksgiving, they can pray all they want: they do not believe and they do not know the truth, and those are the very things that could save their lives.

“And he that trusteth in him shall fare never the worse.” If you believe the commandments and follow the dietary laws, will you be worrying about high blood pressure, high cholesterol, or a foot amputation from diabetes? No, because you are not eating in a way that lets those sicknesses come your way. You will not fear any of it, because you believe the law, and the law tells you the food you can eat and the food you cannot eat.

Here is where the animals were sanctified by the word of God. “Ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.” He says it again in verse 45: “ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.”

“This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth”. This law covers every animal, whether it lives on the earth or in the waters. And why was it given? “To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.”

That is how the word sanctifies: it makes a difference between what can be eaten and what cannot. Some animals are clean and some are unclean; it is basic. The churches don’t want you to learn the Old Testament for one reason only, because they don’t want you to be saved. The scripture says choose life, but if you don’t know what the law says, how are you going to choose life?

How do you become holy, as Leviticus commands? “Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy”.

The law is holy and the commandment is holy. So when the scripture says sanctify yourselves and be holy, it means you have to be applying the laws, statutes and commandments, the dietary laws included. That is what sanctifies a man and what sanctifies his meat.

sense.text: “My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.” To have the life Deuteronomy sets before you, you have to keep the words and lay up the commandments.

“Keep my commandments, and live”. If you are not keeping the laws, you are not going to live. When you are not controlling what you eat, when you keep eating unclean food, you are sinning.

“And my law as the apple of thine eye.” If somebody poked at your arm you would not move very fast, but if somebody tries to put a finger in your eye you move like a flash, because you could go blind. You don’t stop to think it might only scratch; you take no chances. Protect the law the same way. The moment anything tries to make you go against God’s law, move away fast, as the scripture says to flee from sin as from the face of a serpent. Instead, many are like the fly drawn to the light that kills it.

The bar has been raised because the Most High wants us to be a fit army. When Captain Shem ordered that brothers over a certain weight cannot go to camp, it became a test: some will stay home, get comfortable, make excuses, and slowly fall out of the truth, finding that they love food more than they love the Lord. You can’t step in the street teaching people discipline when you don’t have it yourself; they look at your body and won’t listen. And at camp, if something pops off, you become a liability.

Then come the excuses: I’m big boned, my thyroid is acting up. Your bones are not big; you are just big. That is a sort of self-hatred, because you know that thing can kill you and you keep doing it.

We are fighting two sides: ourselves, and Esau, the enemy who put McDonald’s and Burger King in the hood and just wants to feed us garbage. The only way to have life is to keep the commandments as the apple of your eye: no pork, lobster, shrimp, oysters, crabs, snails dressed up as escargot, chitlins or pig feet.

precepts.why:
Sin is what? “Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.”

Eating unclean food is a transgression of the law, and so is not controlling what you eat. So when Proverbs says keep my commandments and live, the man who keeps eating that way is sinning.

“For the wages of sin is death”. Eating pork is going to kill you. Overeating is going to kill you.

Aren’t you supposed to be the temple of God? If you keep eating a certain way you are destroying yourself, destroying the vehicle the Most High gave you. We are all called here to do a job, so why would you work against what the Lord says? Keep the commandments and live; break them and the wages are death.

“Lie not one to another”. Where there is one sin there are many more; a demon doesn’t walk by itself. Being fat brings lying with it. A brother went to the supermarket with a hundred dollars and came back with two or three bags of snacks, and when asked about it, he said no. Now you see what being fat will do.

A brother sent another brother across the street to buy him a big Slurpee, and the other brother watched him from the window drinking out of it on the way back, then hand it over like nothing happened. Another house had trays of bread, and when everyone came home there was not one piece left, crumbs all over one brother’s bed, and he said he didn’t eat it until he finally admitted it. Brothers say they didn’t eat today because all they had was Pringles and honey buns. You steal food and you lie about it.

Get your eating under control as we prepare for the end. All it will take for some to betray us is to be starved for five days and put in a room with a Thanksgiving dinner. As in the Maccabees, the enemy tried to make our people eat swine’s flesh, they will use your weakness against you. Judas betrayed Christ for thirty pieces of silver because he was covetous. If you can’t control yourself around a Slurpee, imagine fried chicken, or a compound where the food has to be rationed and guarded from our own people. Keep the law as the apple of your eye.

sense.text:
When the overeating and the junk are exposed, someone comments that it is bullying. So you want us to let you die? No. The Most High says to give the wicked warning; of course you call it bullying, because you are fat and don’t want to change. When you are in a hospital bed you will remember these classes and realize they were just trying to help you. Yet when a white man in a video says fat people are sugar junkies, addicted to and slaves to their food, nobody calls that bullying. Only when the black man is trying to save your life.

“They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.” What are we saying that is wrong? The law says don’t overeat, and don’t eat what is unhealthy and unlawful. That is speaking uprightly. So it is not us you hate: you hate God, and you love being fat. When the high cholesterol, the high blood pressure and the diabetes hit, you will think, I should have listened.

The food industry is designed to make you overeat. The tobacco companies’ scientists went to the food companies, and now everything has sugar in it, the bread, the ketchup, everything. It is designed to destroy you, not keep you healthy. If we are trying to keep you from falling victim to it, how is that bullying?

“That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the Lord”. The law says don’t overeat; the law says don’t eat unclean animals. But our people don’t want to hear it when those laws are brought out: oh no, that’s bullying. That is why so many stay in Christianity with the pastors who sing about ham and potatoes.

“Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits”. Don’t see my fatness. Don’t see that my cholesterol has me close to dying, that I’m about to lose my foot to diabetes. In the black family, grandmama died of diabetes, mama of high cholesterol, everybody dying of sickness from food, and when we try to change our community, they call it bullying. Go sit your butt somewhere.

They want smooth things: stay fat, you’ll be all right. No, you’re not going to be all right. The doctor knows it and you know it; you are lying to yourself, and you want us to lie to you too.

“Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease”. Basically they want us to stop teaching and switch to smooth things. You really want us to stop teaching the Bible because you hate Christ and want to stay as you are and die. We can’t stop you, but we are going to give you the word of God, and what you do with it is up to you.
“Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon”. Because you despise God’s word.

“Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.” That heart attack is going to come suddenly. That high blood pressure is going to come suddenly. That diabetes is going to come suddenly. One day you thought you were fine and you wake up in a hospital somewhere, and then you will remember this class. Take heed, lest you fall.

We are sick already and have normalized it. Sugar in the blood becomes diabetes, which our people call having the sugar; in the brain, dementia; in the teeth, cavities; in the liver, fatty liver. And it is hidden in everything: a bag of Goldfish, a bottle of Sweet Baby Ray’s, a can of Bush’s baked beans, the white bread, the energy drinks, the processed meats that are not even meat. A nation that is trying to kill you designed it that way.

“My son, prove thy soul in thy life, and see what is evil for it, and give not that unto it.” It is your body, your temple, your choice, but make sure you make the right choice. Based on what you choose to eat, you are choosing death. There are things a man gives to himself that are evil for him; if you feed yourself evil, if you feed yourself poison, you hate yourself. Don’t give that thing unto it.

“For all things are not profitable for all men”. Be careful what you choose to put in your body; find out what is good for you. And whatever kind of man you are, sugar can never be good for anyone. Overconsumption of sugar will put you in a bad situation.

“Be not unsatiable in any dainty thing”. Not just some, any. The Almond Joy has coconut in it; the Snickers has peanuts. It doesn’t matter: any. You can’t pick and choose. The three-layer cake, the donuts, the munchkins, the cupcakes, the brownies, none of it is good for you. The system designed it to make you addicted because they want you dead, chemically castrated and obese, unable to function. Some people eat treats morning, noon and evening and no real food at all.

“Nor too greedy upon meats”. The man in the video breathing hard to push the food down so he can make room for more is being greedy upon meats, and the Bible says don’t do it.

“For excess of meats bringeth sickness, and surfeiting will turn into choler.” When you overeat, you are going to get sick; it is as simple as that. We can’t change it to please you. That man is too big, and very simple things are coming: high cholesterol, high blood pressure, heart attack, stroke or diabetes. Any doctor will tell you the same, and nobody calls the doctor a bully.

The Florida Department of Health found arsenic at elevated levels in 26 of 33 well-known candies; for a child, more than 96 Nerds or eight Swedish Fish in a year is past the safe amount. You hear it straight from Esau, and still say we are bullying. Surfeiting is that late-night bellyache, the belly pain that makes you sick.

“By surfeiting have many perished”. If you keep overeating you are going to die. So is the Bible a bully’s book? No, you just hate God, and you hate yourself, because loving God is the only way to love yourself, and if you can’t love yourself you cannot love me.

Fat does not sit harmlessly under the skin. Visceral fat wraps around the heart, the lungs, the liver and the gut, and makes the organs work double time, so you are always weak, always tired. You don’t feel the pain, so you think nothing is happening, until one day, bam, a stroke, a heart attack, a bypass surgery. You are walking around like a ticking time bomb, and we are trying to keep you out of that hospital bed.

“But he that taketh heed prolongeth his life.” If you take heed to what is written here, you will prolong your life. When you say it is bullying, you are not taking heed, and you will live a very short life. That is not what I say; that is what the Bible says.

precepts.why:
“He that sinneth before his Maker, let him fall into the hand of the physician.” What kind of sin puts you in the physician’s hands? Overeating. The Bible says if you want to live long, don’t do it. But do we take heed? No. It is the man who does not take heed of verse 31 who falls into the hand of the physician.

If you think getting in shape is hard, wait until you have fifteen to twenty years of health problems, a nursing home too early, and medications just to stay alive. Discipline is hard, but the consequences of no discipline are much harder. The disciplined man applies the scriptures; the undisciplined man does exactly what they say not to do.

sense.text: “Eat as it becometh a man, those things which are set before thee”. Don’t devour, gorging food down all day every day. Eat the way you are supposed to eat, to live. The undisciplined man overeats, oversleeps, and is always tired and sluggish.

“And be not unsatiable, lest thou offend.” Some people want to grab everything; their plate looks like a mountain, and after that they eat again. A lot of brothers living near Golden Corrals are in there all day every day. That is not helping you, it is destroying you.
“A very little is sufficient for a man well nurtured”. Very little, because you want to live a long life and be healthy. “And he fetcheth not his wind short upon his bed.”

“Sound sleep cometh of moderate eating”. With too much sugar the brain is overactive and you can’t sleep; sugar keeps you up at night, spiking and crashing your blood sugar, making for restless, lighter sleep and more awakenings, then more sugar cravings the next day. It is a never-ending cycle, and over the years it brings mental problems and mood swings because you are never well rested.

“He riseth early, and his wits are with him”. When you don’t overeat, you can wake up early with all your strength and energy and your wits with you, not dreading another morning. Some people sleep and sleep and are always tired.

Choose your hard: be disciplined to control your eating and exercise. Many people read “For bodily exercise profiteth little” and conclude there is no value in it. But a man may make a little money that profits him a good amount. That little is a lot. Control your eating and do a little exercise, and it will go a very long way.

You need a strong constitution to keep going; your bones have to be strong enough to carry you for a long time. If you never eat what strengthens your bones and never work out your muscles, you will end up on crutches, in a wheelchair, in a hospital bed, deteriorating slowly because you won’t listen to the laws of God and won’t control your mouth. You can’t be on a seafood diet, seeing food and eating it everywhere you go.

Yes, you need to exercise, but the main thing is your diet. One chicken sandwich, large fries, a milkshake and a Coke would take about 40,000 steps, around 20 miles of walking, to burn off, and that is not the only thing you ate that day. Working out keeps your constitution and your organs strong; you lose weight by eating less. Snacking is the biggest problem. And no soda, not even diet: it decalcifies the bones, and you want strong bones to live longer.

Why are our kids always sick? Cereal and Eggos for breakfast, processed food and junk all day, maybe one cooked meal. To save our kids, it starts with you first.

“As is the mother, so is her daughter.” What you are is exactly what your kids are going to be, because a child models himself or herself after the parents. If you are in the house working out, your little ones will want to do push-ups and pull-ups and be in the gym with you. If you like to lie in bed eating ice cream, they will want to lie in bed eating ice cream with you. That is how self-hatred is passed down: in the black American community, grandmama is fat, mama is fat, the kid is fat, and they all give the same excuse, my thyroid, we come from a big-boned family. That’s garbage. Get some help.

Very rarely do you see a fat mother with a skinny daughter, and if there is a son, he is really big too, because what got you there is exactly what is in the house for them to eat. And how can you tell your kids to stop eating when you are eating so much? You will feel like a hypocrite. If there is no candy or donut in the house, can a six-year-old go out and buy any? No. The kid eats what you feed them.

precepts.why:
“Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.” It is you who has to shape and mould the trajectory of the child’s life.

Stop giving your kids choices: put sugary food and good food before a child and he will always choose the sugar, because a child does not know. When your child loves a particular healthy food, give it to him all the time. Train them in every aspect: teach them the laws, show them what is good to eat and what is not, show them how to exercise and do their studies.

If you are big and your kid is big, how would you feel when your young child is diabetic and needs insulin shots because you overfed them and let them eat all kinds of garbage? Where is the love in that? Laziness is why we don’t deal with our kids right, and why we don’t deal with ourselves right. As is the mother, so is the daughter: set the right example by controlling your eating and exercising.

sense.text:
People want a magic pill or a shot. The magic pill is called self-discipline: start applying the law and start loving yourself. Even surgery doesn’t change anything if you keep eating, because the intestine grows back its stretch: the more you eat, the more you want to eat. To lose weight you have to shrink it, and the only way is to cut down the amount of food you eat.

“Give not over thy mind to heaviness, and afflict not thyself in thine own counsel.” Don’t say, I feel bad, so I have to eat. Stop afflicting yourself; stop saying, I can’t lose weight, then getting an ice cream. Say, today’s the day I change. You changed from the Christian church, you changed from believing Christ is white; you have the power in you to change. Fast and pray more. You just have to want it bad enough.

“Love thine own soul, and comfort thy heart”. If you love yourself and love your people, you want to be around to do the work, so you take care of your body to be of good use to the body. We need labourers; why shorten your life with the errors of your life?

“Remove sorrow far from thee: for sorrow hath killed many, and there is no profit therein.” A lot of people eat because they are sad, I eat because I’m sad and I’m sad because I eat, a vicious cycle. By being sorrowful you can just drop dead. But you are an Israelite: what should you be sad about? Every day you get up you should be happy, because at least you know there is salvation for you.
“Envy and wrath shorten the life, and carefulness bringeth age before the time.” Always stressing, you will look old before your time; at forty people will ask if you are sixty.

“A cheerful and good heart will have a care of his meat”. The heart is the mind, and what is good is the law. When the laws of God are in you, you will watch what you eat, and you won’t be sad all day.

Too blessed to be stressed: I’m an Israelite. Everything else can be fixed. What cannot be fixed is being born an Edomite, an Ammonite or a Moabite. You can have everything else right in your life and that can’t be fixed. You were born an Israelite, so be happy. The bill will get paid. Get a job and stop being a bum.

“The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years”. By reason of strength. Seventy percent of how you age is lifestyle, not genetics, and sitting on your butt all day can cut fourteen years off your life. People are dying very young because they don’t take care of themselves.

Where will that strength come from? You have to take care of yourself: eat right and work out, and lift as heavy as you can. It’s not all about being fat; a skinny man can be unhealthy too. Driving to work, sitting eight hours, sitting at lunch, sitting at dinner, sitting in front of the TV, lying in bed: that is the number one killer. Muscle eats off sugar, so the man with no muscle retains the sugar, and the man who never moves dries out his joints.

Don’t fear getting too big. Five pounds of muscle is smaller than five pounds of fat; lifting will make you smaller, stronger and give you the shape you wanted. You won’t become Schwarzenegger overnight; that takes steroids and a lot of eating. Make it a lifestyle, thirty minutes to an hour at least four times a week, so that no one has to tell you to get up. Don’t wait for a doctor to tell you an organ is failing. If you say you believe this book, you were supposed to be applying it. If you have to wait for Esau to tell you, it is too late.

Choose your hard. Being fat is hard on your lungs, your liver, your kidneys and all your organs. If you can’t run, walk, forty-five minutes to an hour every day, and stop stuffing your face. Love your people, love yourself, and take care of your temple.

“Abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul”. When we think of lust we think only of sex, money and power, and we must abstain from those. But there is also lusting after food, and we must abstain from that too. Give yourself over to your appetite and you become a laughing-stock to your enemies. Our enemies want us dead, and as long as we let our lust win, we end up in a hospital bed.

This class is not bullying and it is not to put you down. It is a rude awakening to show you where you are heading. Choose whom you will serve. Big breakfast, big lunch, big dinner and snacks, or a healthy breakfast, lunch and dinner and the gym: the choice is yours. Anyone can die in a car accident, but don’t use that as an excuse. You can eat all the garbage Esau puts out for you, or follow a biblical diet: lawful food, not unsatiable in dainty things, small portions, light meals, plenty of water.

Pray and fast that the Lord keep you disciplined, change your appetite and strip away the cravings for sugar and processed carbs.

“For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit”. If you are deceitful, lying to yourself and others about what you eat, the holy spirit of discipline will not live with you.

“And remove from thoughts that are without understanding”. Understand this: we need you, healthy, to do the work. Your kids need you, and you need yourself. Stop hating yourself, become disciplined, and ask the Lord never to remove his holy spirit from you so you can stay disciplined.

“And will not abide when unrighteousness cometh in.” Stop sinning, because the holy spirit of discipline will not stick around while you are in sin. Stop overeating, stop snacking, fast more, take care of your body and exercise.
